title: How to Create Text to Video with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to generate a video directly from a text prompt, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.
operation: Generate a video directly from a text prompt.
prompt: Generate a 5 second 720P 16:9 video from this prompt using model id wan-2-6-text-to-video. This model requires Starter or higher.
